🤖 Talos triage · confidence: high

Talos can make mistakes. Please check important information.

Verdict
Not a defect — this is a request to build a new report, and the customer's existing cash version already has a matching payment-type filter available for merchandise cards.

What we checked

  • The existing cash refund report is just "refund transactions, filtered to the cash payment group, totalled by dollars and by count per store and cashier" — the same shape works for any other payment group with one filter value changed.

  • This customer's payment-type list already contains merchandise return card entries (issue, reload and redeem), so the value needed for the new filter exists and no new data has to be requested from the customer.

Next

  • Copy the cash refund ranking report, swap the payment-type filter from cash to store/merchandise credit, keep the same columns, ranking and date window, and save it in the same folder as the cash report.

  • Run it over a recent 30-day window and compare the dollar and count totals against the example the customer attached.

Hi @rauran@pacificsunwear.com

Thank you for putting together the example and the screenshots, they made this one easy to follow.

The MERCH CARD REFUNDS w Ranking Dollars Count report is now available in your LP Investigative Reports folder under Quick Links, right next to your CASH version. It uses the same columns, prompts and ranking.

From what I am seeing, merch card refunds come through on return transactions with the Gift Card tender, so that is what the report counts. I also left out store 4905, since online returns there are not tied to a store cashier.

Whenever you have a moment, could you run it for a period you know well and let me know if the totals match what you expect? If you would rather include store 4905, I am happy to add it back.

If you would like any column or prompt adjusted, just reply here and I will take care of it.

Kind Regards,
Juan Martinez
Appriss Retail Support
